messages:
Maria G: Quick pulse — dashboard shows ~14% drop in MQLs starting Wed afternoon. Not tied to traffic dip.
Jason K: Hmm, did messaging changes go out Wed? I pushed the new hero copy Tuesday night.
Liam S: Yep, messaging iteration went live 02:12am Wed — split A/B with 60/40.
Priya R: 60/40? We meant 50/50 for the experiment. Can you paste the experiment config?
Liam S: pasted config in analytics channel but quick query: `SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) as leads FROM inbound WHERE date >= '2024-05-01' GROUP BY cohort;`
Ava M: Sharing dashboard link: <https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/marketing-weekly> — see top-left chart (MQL by variant).
Maria G: Looking at topology, variant B underperforms by ~20% on CVR. Could explain the drop.
Jason K: If B is 40% of traffic and converts 20% worse, overall MQLs drop ≈ 8%. We're seeing 14% so still a gap.
Priya R: Also check attribution window — we recently switched GA4 default from 7d to 1d for last-touch. That can make numbers look lower.
Liam S: Good call. ProductBot: audit event — analytics-config changed: attribution.window=1d by @PriyaR at 2024-05-08T03:05Z.
Jason K: If attribution shortened + worse variant B, multiplicative effect. Need to separate effects.
Maria G: Proposed plan: 1) revert attribution to 7d in parallel reporting for 48h, 2) pause variant B rollout to 20% and re-evaluate, 3) run a quick cohort-level attribution join to isolate impact.
Ava M: I can run the cohort join and surface CSV by EOD. @Liam can you throttle variant B?
Liam S: Throttling to 20% now. Will confirm in 5m.
Priya R: I'll flip the parallel 7d view now and tag historical diffs.
Jason K: Also request — add a widget showing 'attribution window' sensitivity (1d vs 7d) so we don't chase false negatives.
Maria G: Agreed. Add small note in weekly KPI deck for Friday: root-cause hypotheses + actions.
Ava M: CSV uploaded: <https://s3.redwood/marketing/mql_cohorts_20240509.csv> — includes variant, timestamp, source, attribution_window.
Liam S: Throttle confirmed. Variant B -> 20%. Reaction :thumbsup:
